tests.name: parse_string_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::parse using string iterator pairs to verify correct parsing via pointer range optimization.

tests.name: parse_vector_char_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::parse using vector of char iterator pairs.

tests.name: parse_vector_const_char_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::parse using vector const_iterator pairs.

tests.name: parse_vector_unsigned_char_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::parse using std::vector<unsigned char> iterators.

tests.name: parse_vector_signed_char_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::parse using std::vector<signed char> iterators.

tests.name: accept_string_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::accept using string iterator pairs.

tests.name: accept_empty_range
tests.intent: Probes json::accept on an empty string iterator range, verifying that empty ranges are not dereferenced.

tests.name: parse_empty_range_exception
tests.intent: Probes json::parse on an empty string iterator range to ensure proper exception handling without dereference.

tests.name: sax_parse_string_iterators
tests.intent: Probes sax_parse using string iterator pairs with a custom SAX consumer.

tests.name: from_cbor_vector_iterators
tests.intent: Probes binary reader from_cbor using vector<uint8_t> iterator pairs.

tests.name: from_msgpack_vector_iterators
tests.intent: Probes binary reader from_msgpack using vector<char> iterator pairs.

tests.name: from_ubjson_vector_iterators
tests.intent: Probes binary reader from_ubjson using vector iterator pairs.

tests.name: from_bson_vector_iterators
tests.intent: Probes binary reader from_bson using vector iterator pairs.

tests.name: non_byte_vector_fallback
tests.intent: Probes json::parse with a vector of integers (non-byte, e.g. int) to ensure it falls back correctly to general iterators.

tests.name: list_iterator_fallback
tests.intent: Probes json::parse with std::list<char> iterators to verify non-contiguous container fallback path.

tests.name: string_subrange_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::parse using a sub-range (iterators not starting at begin()) of a std::string.

tests.name: vector_subrange_iterators
tests.intent: Probes json::parse using a sub-range of a std::vector<char>.

tests.name: string_iterator_error_position
tests.intent: Probes error reporting position accuracy when parsing invalid JSON via string iterators.

tests.name: vector_const_iterator_error_position
tests.intent: Probes error reporting position accuracy when parsing invalid JSON via vector const_iterators.

tests.name: vector_bool_iterators_fallback
tests.intent: Probes std::vector<bool> iterators to confirm they do not match the 1-byte byte container optimization (since vector<bool> packs bits).

tests.intent: Probes json::parse using vector const_iterator pairs.

tests.intent: Probes binary reader from_bson using vector iterator pairs.
